We went in July: the last tour on weekends is 17:00, so you can easily fit it in after lunch.

# Tours and opening hours

Updated 2026-09-01.

Guided tours run every hour on the hour. From 1 September the last tour on Saturdays and Sundays is at 15:00 (winter timetable); weekday last tour is 14:00.
